description.en: Writes a temporary map byte flag (only the low 8 bits of the value are kept). Temporary map byte flags are a table of byte values (0 to 255) in the flag data, right after the temporary map bit flags. The number is not checked and the table size was not traced.

true (also when the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A per-map counter (not found in script_clean/; invented)
